title: Museum of One source-qualified catalogue profile
description: A local application profile with evidence-scoped identity and export rules; not an external certification.
x-identity-rules: Separate Work, deposited edition, version family, file, catalogue description and webpage.
All contextual entity references use the shared entity URI.
An exact institutional edition match requires the selected DOI in linked_zenodo_dois.
x-export-rules: Only evidenced edition_format ISBN allocation is emitted as edition ISBN.
Citation title is source_title, with display title as fallback only when absent.
Unknown creation dates and reviewers remain unknown; source review is not live external verification.
x-validation: scripts/metadata_profile.py validates required fields, types, patterns, cardinality, URI/date semantics, scoped assertions and whole-graph references.
